newsitem.title: USA: Oasis Residential files $250 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Oasis Residential files $250 mln shelf.

text.p: Oasis Residential Inc filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday to sell up to $250 million in debt securites and common and preferred stock and warrants.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, wihch may include the acquisition of land parcels, the development of new apartment properties, the acquisition of existing apartment properties, the repayment of indebtedness or the renovation of properties in Oasis's portfolio.

The Henderson, Nevada,-based company is a self-administered and self-managed equity real-estate investment trust. It is a developer and owner of predominately upscale apartment communities in the greater Las Vegas area.
